name: The Kid at the Back
source:
"There's this guy, pretty tall guy, often times people don't even realize he's there but he is. Usually sits at the back, wears nothing but black. His eyes however, were bright, red as the autumn leaves, and they for sure aren't leaving your eyes once you lock with his." 

[From [url=https://fantasia-kittcat.itch.io/the-kid-at-the-back-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“有一个人，个子很高，很多时候人们都没有意识到他在那里，但他确实在那里。通常坐在后面，只穿黑色衣服。但是他的眼睛明亮，像秋天的树叶一样红，一旦你锁定他，他们就不会离开你的眼睛。” 

[来自[url=https://fantasia-kittcat.itch.io/the-kid-at-the-back-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
